title: The fortune within the secret realm is finally complete
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji tucked the Tianji Record into his chest, a sharp sword intent pierced through the air from the direction of Tianqing Sect—Su Qingyao, she had finally caught up.

text.content: The figure in the time-space rift had deep-set eyes, yet they burst with astonishing divine light: 'Child... the destiny you carry is even older than the Tianji Record...' That voice seemed to traverse ancient millennia, carrying an irresistible sorrow and hope. Within Chen Ji's bloodline, the sealed gate of memories spanning ten thousand years was slowly opening, countless fragmented images flooding into his mind like a tide—ancient altars, fallen gods and demons, and a pair of eyes identical to his own.

'Um...' Chen Ji groaned, his Mental Sea churning with tremendous waves. The fragmented memories pierced his heart like ten thousand arrows, yet he clenched his teeth, refusing to let out a cry of pain. These images were too ancient, far beyond his ability to distinguish truth from falsehood. But one thing he was absolutely certain of—Ling Yuan, who claimed to have been 'skipped' by the Tianji Record, probably knew this secret long ago.

Just as the torrent of memories was about to overwhelm him, the golden core within his body shuddered violently. The spiritual energy accumulated during his secret realm trials erupted completely, turning into a rushing torrent that scoured his meridians. The barrier of the Transformation God realm shattered under this force's collision, and a dazzling golden pill condensed in his dantian—Golden Core Middle Stage!

dialogue.content: Ye Qing stepped out of the void riding demonic mist, her extremely beautiful face showing a rare solemnity: 'What did you just... see?' Her intuition told her something terrible was happening to thistrash—her demonic path's fog couldn't completely hide that blood pulse's trembling.

text.content: Chen Ji slowly opened his eyes, golden light flickering in his pupils before vanishing. He didn't answer Ye Qing's question, instead turning his gaze to the Tianji Record in his embrace. The three pages of fragments were trembling at some mysterious frequency, emitting a faint glow and resonating with each other.

In an instant, a flood of information poured into his Mental Sea. The three-page united Tianji Record displayed unprecedented might—the foresight duration extended from three hours to twelve hours, the clarity of foreseen visions increased severalfold, and even the originally blurry fragments began to clarify. Yet that image of his sister Chen Nian, which had troubled him for so long, remained shrouded in mist.

dialogue.content: 'Do you remember the seven-day agreement, Night Saint?' Chen Ji tucked the Tianji Record into his chest, a faint smile curving his lips. 'Since we've decided to cooperate, these are the bottom lines—demonic path intelligence, cultivation resources, and everything about the Holy Sect's internal affairs. If even one term is unmet, this agreement is void.'

choice.prompt: Ye Qing slightly raised her brow, seemingly quite surprised by thistrash的 tough attitude. How should Chen Ji finalize this alliance?

choices.description: Proactively lower conditions, demonstrate cooperative sincerity, and win Ye Qing's trust

text.content: Upon hearing this, a playful glint flashed in Ye Qing's eyes: 'You're more straightforward than those hypocritical righteous path cultivators.' She drew from her sleeve a token black as ink. 'This item can mobilize personnel from three outer posts of the Holy Sect—within seven days, it's at your disposal.'

choices.text: Combine kindness and threat, reveal trump card
choices.description: Hint that the Tianji Record has changed, making Ye Qing realize the value of cooperation
choices.risk_hint: May invite more probing from Ye Qing

text.content: Chen Ji's fingertip凝聚 a wisp of golden spiritual power, forming a虚幻 eye hovering above his palm. The Tianji Record's power aura made Ye Qing's pupils contract sharply—this force even exceeded her knowledge of prophetic treasures. 'Pleasant cooperation.' she said softly, her tone carrying more genuine solemnity.

choices.description: Make no statements, let Ye Qing proactively increase the stakes

text.content: Ye Qing stared at him for several breaths, then suddenly laughed lightly: 'Interesting.' She flicked her hand, and three jade slips emanating rich spiritual energy fell into Chen Ji's hands. 'The private accounts of the Holy Sect's three elders, the location of the Forbidden Grounds entrance, and—the specific location of Chen Nian's imprisonment.'

Chen Ji accepted the jade slips, his神识 scanning them. His face remained impassive, but his heart was churning with tremendous waves. The Holy Sect's three elders' private accounts involved secret transactions of at least three sect elders, and the location of the Forbidden Grounds entrance was crucial intelligence he had been desperately seeking all along—and finally, there was definite news of Chen Nian's whereabouts.

'In seven days, I'll send someone to receive you.' Ye Qing's figure began to fade, leaving only a profound statement: 'Chen Ji, I'm betting you can survive this round. I hope you don't disappoint me.' The demonic mist dissipated, and silence once again filled the secret realm.

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's voice drifted from the first page: 'Three pages resonate, duration extended... Master, though your strength has increased, the real test is just beginning. That existence in the rift—do you believe its words?'

choice.prompt: Chen Ji gripped the jade slip tightly, feeling the surging golden core power within his body. A three-month deadline was enough for him to do many things, but what should he do first?

choices.description: Enter closed cultivation to thoroughly stabilize the golden core realm, avoiding hidden dangers from unstable foundation
choices.visible_reward: Combat power greatly increases, foundation solidifies

text.content: Chen Ji sat cross-legged, the golden core slowly rotating in his dantian, madly absorbing the residual spiritual energy of the secret realm. His aura gradually turned inward, every cell undergoing transformation. This坐 lasted seven days.

choices.text: Plan the world, stir the winds
choices.description: Use the Tianji Record's new abilities to plant chess pieces in the three major sects, laying groundwork for future reversals
choices.visible_reward: Control the initiative, gain substantial intelligence

text.content: The Tianji Record flipped, countless visions flowing before Chen Ji's eyes. He saw the power shift within Xuanwu Sect, a major upheaval about to occur in Tianqing Sect, and even a secret entrance to the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path. Three chess pieces were quietly buried deep in the board.

choices.description: Research the blurry prophecies related to Chen Nian, attempt to find clues to end the Heavenly Fate consumption
choices.visible_reward: May find method to break the chains

text.content: Chen Ji stared at Chen Nian's blurry figure on the Tianji Record, his fingertip gently tracing her outline. In an instant, a faint light emanated from his fingertip, and a hazy voice sounded in his ear: '...find... jade...door...'

'Jade door...' Chen Ji repeated this key phrase, his mind racing through information related to it. There were legends of jade doors in ancient ruins, but the specific records had long been lost. He put away the jade slips, deciding to note this clue first and investigate thoroughly when the time was ripe.

The exit light of the secret realm grew brighter and brighter. Chen Ji knew it was time for him to leave. He straightened his clothes, suppressing his aura to the level of early Transformation God realm—this cultivation level would still be unremarkable at Tianqing Sect, but enough to make some people lower their guard. Playing the pig to eat the tiger—his favorite act.

The moment Chen Ji stepped out of the secret realm, he keenly sensed several神识 scanning from different directions. One was sharp as a sword—it was Su Qingyao's aura. She had indeed been monitoring him all along, and her cultivation had progressed even further—she probably had touched the threshold of the Void Refining realm.

dialogue.content: Just as Chen Ji entered Tianqing Sect's territory, a sword energy pierced through the air, slicing off a strand of hair by his ear. Su Qingyao's figure stepped out of the void, her face like frost: 'Three months apart, your cultivation has indeed progressed greatly. Chen Ji, how many secrets are you hiding?'

text.content: Chen Ji touched his ear, looking at the飘落的white hair, his heart secretly lamenting the可惜, yet his face showed only panic: 'Su Senior Sister, spare my life! The disciple merely stumbled upon some fortune in the secret realm, the cultivation progress was truly accidental, absolutely no concealment!' He even squeezed out a few tears, perfectly portraying a petty person who got lucky but feared being held accountable.

choice.prompt: Su Qingyao's gaze was like a sword, almost piercing through Chen Ji. She was approaching the truth for the third time—which method should he use to defuse it this time?

choices.text: Implement the flesh-and-blood strategy, show weakness
choices.description: Deliberately reveal flaws, induce Su Qingyao to investigate further, let her discover some 'truth' during the investigation
choices.visible_reward: Su Qingyao temporarily lowers her guard
choices.risk_hint: May make Su Qingyao even more interested

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao stared at him for a long while, then suddenly coldly laughed: 'Atrash is still atrash, even acting is so fake.' She withdrew her sword energy, turned to leave, yet her背影 carried an imperceptible disappointment. Chen Ji wiped the cold sweat from his forehead—it seemed this time his acting needed improvement.

choices.description: Ask Su Qingyao why she cares so much about his cultivation, turning passive to active

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao's footsteps paused, she looked back at Chen Ji, a strange glint flickering in her eyes: 'You've learned to ask counterquestions.' A playful arc curved her lips. 'Interesting, I'm becoming more and more curious—who exactly are you?'

choices.description: Deliberately or unintentionally let Su Qingyao discover the Tianji Record's existence, establishing a deeper bond
choices.visible_reward: Su Qingyao may become a true ally

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao's神识 swept over the Tianji Record in Chen Ji's embrace, her pupils contracting sharply. She fell silent for a long while, her voice carrying an unusual gentleness: 'Chen Ji, I don't know what you're planning, but if you need help... the position of Inner Disciple Senior Fellow at Tianqing Sect, I can give it to you anytime.'

choices.memory_label: 苏青瑶好感度达到可信任阈值

text.content: Su Qingyao's words made Chen Ji slightly stunned. He raised his eyes to look at this aloof female cultivator, yet in her eyes he saw a seriousness he had never seen before. This woman... was more troublesome and more dangerous than he imagined. She wasn't an enemy, but she was equally not an ally who could be easily trusted.

'Thank you for the kind offer, Su Senior Sister.' Chen Ji lowered his eyes, hiding the complex emotions in his gaze. 'However, this disciple is merely a Servant Disciple, being content with one's station is enough. As for those fortuitous encounters...' He paused. 'Perhaps they're just a joke played by heaven.'

Su Qingyao deeply glanced at him, then turned and left on her sword. As the sword light disappeared into the clouds, Chen Ji slowly raised his head, gazing at the direction of her departure, a hint of tenderness flickering in his eyes that he rarely showed. This woman was the only existence that made him feel棘手. She was too clever, too sharp, too difficult to deal with.

But precisely because of this, he couldn't let her be drawn into this漩涡. Chen Ji gripped the Tianji Record tightly, feeling the surging power from the three-page resonance, a faint smile curving his lips. Three months was enough for him to do many things. Ling Yuan, Ye Qing, the Holy Sect, the Forbidden Grounds... all the chess pieces were slowly moving on his board.
